::: {.oneline}
Expectation values require evolution operators on both sides of the observable. Ordering them along a single contour that runs forward and then back makes Wick's theorem and the diagrammatic machinery work again.
:::

## Short answer

*To write.* Expectation values require evolution operators on both sides of the observable. Ordering them along a single contour that runs forward and then back makes Wick's theorem and the diagrammatic machinery work again.
